The same reason RemoteTransform is a currently a node, for a convenience that I believe everybody would want and use.
answers.workaround:
---
Although I believe it would be used often, if not that yes, it can be worked around easily
```
node.translation=node.translation.linear_interpolate(translation,lerp_amount)
node.rotation_degrees=node.rotation_degrees.linear_interpolate(rotation_degrees,lerp_amount)
```
However, I believe this is irrelevant because RemoteTransform as it is now can also be worked around with a few lines of script 
```
transform=node.transform, rotation_degrees=node.rotation_degrees, scale=node.scale
```
